name: Voice for MiracleClaw
subtitle: Push-to-talk chat input
description: Capture audio with cpal, transcribe locally with whisper.cpp, drop the transcript into any chat surface. No audio ever leaves your machine.

name: Email Writer for MiracleClaw
subtitle: Cold outreach, follow-ups, and reply drafting via MAIC
description: Drop a few bullet points into MAIC chat and get a complete email — cold outreach, follow-up, or reply. Pick a tone (formal / friendly / direct / casual) and the channel (email / LinkedIn DM). The sidecar composes a tailored draft and returns the body.

name: Calendar Assistant
subtitle: Google + Outlook via MAIC OAuth broker
description: Connect a Google or Outlook calendar through MAIC's OAuth broker. List today's events, schedule meetings, check availability — all in natural language from the chat.

name: PDF & Document Parser for MiracleClaw
subtitle: Extract, summarize, and ask about PDFs, DOCX, and text files
description: Drop-in document parser for MAIC chat. Extracts text from PDF, DOCX, DOC, RTF, TXT, MD. Pipes long documents to MAIC for summarization or Q&A — your files stay local until MAIC sees the extracted text. OCR for scanned PDFs and image-based documents ships in v0.2.

name: Local OCR
subtitle: Extract text from images via MAIC vision
description: Extract text from any image (PNG/JPG/WebP/PDF-page). Routes through your MAIC tenant's vision tool — your images stay in your own MAIC, never reach a third party. For offline / privacy-strict use, see OCR Local (Tesseract) coming in v0.2.

name: Translation for MiracleClaw
subtitle: Text translation via MAIC
description: Translate text or web pages between 100+ languages. Drop-in tool for MAIC chat.

name: YouTube Transcript for MiracleClaw
subtitle: Fetch transcript, summary, and chapter breakdown for any YouTube video
description: Paste a YouTube URL into MAIC chat — get the full transcript with timestamps, an AI-generated summary, and chapter breakdown. Uses youtube-transcript.io (no API key needed) as the primary transcript source, with YouTube's timedtext API as the fallback.

name: Text-to-Speech
subtitle: Read MAIC responses aloud
description: Read MAIC's responses aloud in chat. Two providers: bundled eSpeak NG (offline, free) or MAIC cloud TTS (natural voices via OpenAI TTS-1, $15 per 1M characters). Free tier gets 25K chars per 30 days on cloud; Pro is unlimited.

name: Lead Generator for MiracleClaw
subtitle: Find and enrich prospects from public web sources
description: Worldwide, industry-agnostic lead generator. Searches public signals (Reddit JSON, Craigslist RSS, public Facebook posts, public X search) and optionally enriches results via your FireCrawl module proxy. Draft personalized outreach templates. Bring your own API keys per provider. Localhost-only proxy; your keys stay in your OS keychain.

name: CRM Sync
subtitle: Push contacts to HubSpot, Pipedrive, Notion
description: Push enriched contacts and lead status to HubSpot, Pipedrive, and Notion. MAIC structures the data; CRM Sync delivers it via API.

name: FireCrawl for MiracleClaw
subtitle: Scrape, crawl, search, extract — localhost-only proxy
description: Localhost-only FireCrawl-compatible HTTP proxy. Same /v2 endpoints (scrape, crawl, map, search, extract), but bound to 127.0.0.1 with rate limiting and your API key stored in your OS keychain. Wire-protocol compatible with FireCrawl — bring your own fc- key.
